summary:
Backend-only FINAL P0 retest after iter17 fix to _weekly_model_tuning_loop (server.py:2352-2396 now re-applies step-floor + recomputes grade/confidence + includes them in the $set). ALL TESTS PASS. 17/17 (14 iter17 suite + 3 iter18 follow-up).

— Iter17 root cause CLOSED: the loop's $set now persists grade & confidence. Verified end-to-end across THREE separate natural-fire cycles of the loop (10:36:06, 10:39:59 post-restart, and one mid-test) — DB stayed clean each time. Pre-fix this exact path produced 68 wrong_pass picks per cycle; post-fix produced 0.

— Grade consistency (API + DB): 0 picks with lock>=85 & grade='Pass', 0 legacy grades, 0 lock>99 overflow, 0 tier-mapping mismatches. DB distinct grades today are exactly {'Elite Lock','Lock','Pass','Playable','Strong Lock'} across 281 picks (115-119 served on /api/picks/today).

— Forced reproduction confirmed: `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` → waited for the 180s startup tuning fire (`Weekly model tuning: 10 active buckets, 110 picks re-weighted` at 10:39:59) → re-audited API+DB → 0 wrong_pass. Pre-fix this same sequence reliably yielded 68 wrong_pass.

— Loop-body parity test: re-implemented server.py:2352-2390 verbatim against the live open-pick set, then audited DB → 0 wrong_pass / 0 mismatch / 0 overflow.

— Tier-mapping spec verified per pick: `_grade(lock)` matches stored grade for all 281 open picks today.

— Sort toggle: lock/edge/time/win × asc/desc all monotonic, top-10 IDs differ between desc and asc.

— High-risk parlay 72h: 3 cards × 9 legs each, survival 11.7–12.0%.

— Auto-expand: 4h→72h and 6h→72h fire; 8h served directly (slate-rich, expected). All three windows return 3 parlays.

minor.issue: Step-5 counts['fixed_grade'] still not pre-initialised at line 42-45 — when no grades need fixing the key drops out of the log line. Cosmetic only; functionality is correct. Carried over from iter17.

action_items: OPTIONAL — pick_validator.py:42-45 pre-init `'fixed_grade': 0` in counts dict for stable log shape (cosmetic only). Not a blocker; no functional impact.

OPTIONAL DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH — learning_engine.apply_learning (line 263) mutates pick['lock_score'] without setting pick['grade']/pick['confidence']. The caller currently handles the re-sync correctly, but if any future caller forgets, drift returns. Consider setting pick['grade'] = _grade(new_lock) inside apply_learning itself.

rca_of_issue: RCA (iter18 — final): The iter17 fix landed at server.py:2352-2396. The loop body now re-applies the bet-quality step-function floor BEFORE the $set, recomputes grade + confidence from the new lock_score via sports_engine._grade/_confidence, and writes both fields in the $set payload alongside lock_score/win_probability/edge_percent/implied_probability/learning. Verification today: (a) 3 separate natural-fire cycles of the loop produced 0 drift; (b) forced restart cycle (sleep 200s for the 180s startup timer) also produced 0 drift; (c) loop-body parity test (re-implementing the loop verbatim and running it against live open picks) produced 0 drift. The drift root cause that travelled from soccer/predictor (iter16) → weekly_tuning (iter17) is now sealed at the only remaining mutation site.
